violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. - Raw Chicken found above raw lamb, raw pork, raw beef in walk-in cooler.
Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --- In-use utensil found without handle found in flour.
Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. - Fryer on left is not under hood system.
Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. - Need for Chlorine - dishwasher.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. - Togo cups found on floor in back hallway.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. - Walk-in cooler floor needs repair, raw wood showing through.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical warewashing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration - Found at 0ppm CL at time of inspection. Staff to use 3 comp sink to sanitize until fixed.
Clean clothes, hair restraints, fingernail maint., jewelry, eating/drinking (1 pt deducted)
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
